name: RedHead Camo Utility Waterproof Rubber Boots for Men - 9 M
description: Ready for whatever the day brings, RedHead Camo Utility Rubber Boots for Men keep your feet dry and comfortable around the yard, the farm, the woods, or wherever your day takes you. Built around naturally insulating neoprene rubber bootie uppers, the Camo Utility Boots provide the 100% waterproof protection, natural insulation, and light weight of neoprene. Durable rubber overlays protect feet from rocks, sticks, and other hazards. Built-in kick rims make hands-free removal a snap, while the rear pull tab inside the collar helps you slip into these boots easily. Boots also feature removable insoles and steel shanks for welcome stability over any terrain. Molded rubber outsoles provide sure footing over a variety of terrains and surfaces. Barnyard acid resistant. Average weight per pair: 5 lbs. Imported.
